notes.title: Pushing for August Release
notes.notes:
As many may or may not have been noticing there are have been some activity on Steam in preparing the release of the long awaited short game Wizard's Quest. Yes, I have been pushing for a release date for August 19th in which I hope everything will be in order by then.

My biggest challenge right now is getting the cast on board to finish their roles to include English dub for the character's dialogue to provide a better Role Playing experience. In case that doesn't happen I will still provide the full game on the release date....This time and will include the English dub in the next patch. So this leads into the next thing I would like to share.

Since this game does not have dlc it is because the content is free and is provided through patches. This project has gone through a number of setbacks and for something so small taking as long as 6 years to finish should have been a bigger game. So with that said I will let you all know and keep up to date with announcements as best as I can.

Thank you all for your interest and support, please do check out the Wizard's Quest Blog in tumblr, Wordpress, Facebook, Twitter, and Linkdin.
